test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: At 6:00 a.m., a wrist watch’s hour hand is showing north-west, which direction will hour hand show at 9:00 p.m.?
solution:
When the wrist watch’s hour hand is showing north-west direction **at 6:00 a.m.**, we can represent it as follows:

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2653e5e4ad4f08bd0ea590263c828618ed0d483f3fc922f591fdfdb0c80dfe35.png] 

So, when the wristwatch shows **9:00 p.m**., we get:

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5ce68e96e95b112844828c08a5be1f697a5c5a178d1a96354dd3c4ab09d6d685.png] 

The hour hand is in the **North-East direction** when the wristwatch shows 9:00 p.m.

Hence, the correct answer is **" North - East ".**
